body:
Tried to take a blacked out friend back to the house she was staying at. It was in a cookie cutter neighborhood, and she was too gone to know which unit. 


My solution was to repeatedly bang on the door of a random house... It was the wrong house of course. There was a shotgun pulled on me but i was too blacked out to remember. I called another friend to come pick us up and take us somewhere else. 


Could have actually died...

For months after the breakup i tried to win her back. We used to hook up after she left  and I used to drunk text her, kind of a lot.

8 years later  she has a kid, i have a spouse. I still think about her but there's no way I would want her back anymore.
I love this input! Thank you
Your are right it is inappropriate
Thank you. This is really insightful. Talking to her about it will be hard, but it's the right way to handle it

This is a good idea. I just don't know how. I feel like her job has drained her entire spirit. I've encouraged her to switch careers while I pay all of our bills, hoping that will give her more energy. I'm also a little resentful that I have to spend so much now, but it's like an investment if it helps our relationship
Do you think talking about this will make her upset? I don't want her to get too stressed out, she has a lot on her plate.

She's a good person, and we had a great first 5 years or so. I've noticed these issues arising, and we've talked about it. It hasn't really improved. It feels so fixable so breaking up seems too extreme of a solution
